collection.title: Mercedes-Benz E Class Coupe 2013 to 2017 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Mercedes-Benz E Class Coupe 2013 to 2017 (207) model requires a 24" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Push Button arm attachment.
